ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution. Low-intensity (black) pixels comprise approximately 72% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels forming the remaining 28% in localized patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous mass across proximal and central lobes. High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated in the distal half of the right lobe (image-right) as large contiguous circular blobs. The left lobe (image-left) displays smaller, fragmented high-intensity pixel islands along the trailing boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 112 degrees. The vertex of the notch is partially obscured by high-intensity (white) water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks ranges from 4 to 16 pixels. The right lobe distal edge exhibits higher amplitude 'teeth' compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trapezoidal orientation with a distinct concave curvature along the trailing edge boundary leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters detected; most prominent concentration is on the distal right lobe. Scattered smaller circular disruptions appear in the lower-central region of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear marks (white) visible on the left lobe, crossing the black pixel base at approximately 45-degree angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged pixel-loss pattern on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe (image-right), deviating from the expected geometric lobe curve.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated circular high-intensity 'ring' pattern located in the lower-right quadrant of the central fluke body.
